extDescription: Dual subtitles (EN + RU) in any HTML5 player, word translation on hover and word learning.
busy_find_player: Looking for the player on the page…
history_empty_on: Videos you watched with Double Sub will appear here, so you can continue where you stopped.
history_empty_off: Saving history is off. You can turn it on in settings.
words_empty_text: Click a word in the subtitles to save it. Then review it here.
review_done_text: Words reviewed: $1. The next ones will return when their time comes.
set_sites_empty: Turn on “Start by itself” on a page with a player: next time it will be found without a click on the icon.
set_keep_history_hint: The list of videos is kept only in this browser
voice_random: Mixed: a new voice for every word
voice_online: Online (the word is sent to a server)
voices_more_mac: More voices: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices.
voices_more_windows: More voices: Settings → Time & language → Speech → Add voices.
voices_more_other: More voices can be added in the speech settings of your system.
type_sdh: for the deaf (sound descriptions will be removed)
decision_a: There are English and Russian subtitles: both tracks will be shown.
decision_b_en: There are only English subtitles: the Russian ones will be translated.
decision_b_ru: There are only Russian subtitles: the English ones will be translated.
decision_c: There are no full subtitles. Try another player on the page.
hero_restricted: The extension cannot work on this page.
hero_click_text: Click the Double Sub icon in the browser toolbar while this page is open. The player will be found by itself. To avoid clicking every time, turn on automatic start for the site.
others_hint: There are more videos on the page ($1): the subtitles may be in another player. Click “Choose another player”.
tracks_none: No subtitles found in this player.
picking_title: Videos found: $1. Choose the player on the page.
picking_text: Click the frame on the video you need. Esc on the page cancels.
several_title: There are several videos on the page ($1).
several_text: Choose which of them needs dual subtitles.
access_title: Access to the player is needed.
access_text: The player is embedded from another site. Allow the extension to work with it only; other sites stay unavailable.
access_pick_here: Choose among the videos on this page
nothing_title: No video found on the page.
nothing_text: If the player is still loading, click “Search again”.
reload_search: Reload the page and search from the start
remember_text: Next time the player will be found by itself and the subtitles will appear at once, without a click on the icon.
remember_denied: Access was not granted, the site was not remembered.
auto_hint: Next time the player will be found without a click on the icon
auto_denied: Access to the site was not granted, automatic start is off.
mirrors_label: Recognize my sites at other addresses too
mirrors_hint: Mirrors with the same name (for example lordfilm) and sites by IP address. Access to all sites is needed only to compare the address with your list.
mirrors_denied: Access was not granted, mirrors are off.
watch_pause: Pause while the pointer is on the subtitles
trb_needs_model: $1: translation needs a Chrome language model. It is a one-time download; after that translation works offline.
trb_unavailable: $1: the built-in Chrome translator is not available for this language pair.
chip_ready_b_en: Subtitles ready · EN, I will translate the Russian
chip_ready_b_ru: Subtitles ready · RU, I will translate the English
chip_none: No subtitles found in the player
chip_no_full: No full subtitles in the player
chip_waiting_film: Waiting for the video to start · looking for subtitles
chip_youtube_blocked: YouTube did not give the subtitles · turn off other extensions
youtube_blocked_text: YouTube did not give the subtitles. Turn off other subtitle extensions and reload the page.
tr_needs_model: A translation model is needed: open Double Sub and download it
tr_unavailable: Translation is not available in this Chrome
tr_stopped: Translation stopped: open Double Sub and retry
tip_needs_model: A translation model is needed: open Double Sub and download it
tip_unavailable: Translation is not available in this Chrome
picker_hint: Double Sub: click the video you need · Esc to cancel
